seedReviews.note: Good location and easy to get into town, but the bedrooms were cold in winter and condensation built up quickly unless windows stayed open.

demoFlats.title: Kelburn demo flat
demoFlats.note: Demo review marker showing a stronger rental experience.

seedReviews.note: A surprisingly dry flat for the area. It still needed heating during colder weeks, but maintenance was handled quickly and the place felt secure.

demoFlats.title: Mount Cook demo flat
demoFlats.note: Demo review marker showing a warning-style score.

seedReviews.note: The location was useful, but the flat was damp and repairs took too long. It would need real improvements before I would suggest it to someone else.
